text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Princess, I know that you can become a
great
queen. It will be all right—go and
tell everyone
how you truly feel."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Princess, I know that you can become a
great
queen. It will be all right—go and
tell everyone
how you truly feel."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "Of course. I must share these feelings of mine with Dark Princess—no, with my friend."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"So please watch over me... as I become
a brilliant
queen!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's finally here! The Queen Elizabeth II
Cup!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
H... Hyugh... Trainer?! What do I do?! I...
this
race...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ha-hah! You're scared stiff! And after all
that big
talk about strolling into first.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Can you even run in that sorry state?
Guess I'm
taking the prize this year too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I'm not letting you take first
place! You'll
be left speechless when
this is all over!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Well, then do your worst—if you can, that is! Hehe, this is gonna be fun!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win, Trainer! No true
princess would
let her dream race slip
through her fingers!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can let Sweep win this
one!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
So this time of year has arrived again.
Another
superb race symbolizing
strength, radiance, and
beauty.

text_block_list.name: Lady with Hat
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'm eager to see the coronation of
another
Umamusume fit for the title of
queen, like Mejiro
Dober and Fine
Motion.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Whoever emerges as queen,
I hope
it's someone I can wholeheartedly
admire.
